Atlassian.note: @atlaskit/tokens; in dark mode the raised surface is lighter than the page

Australian Government (AGDS).note: @ag.ds-next/react gold theme (light; its 'dark' palette is for brand-coloured sections, not dark mode)

Adobe Spectrum.note: @adobe/spectrum-tokens; hover and borders are palette steps, as Spectrum has no single neutral hover or border alias

Material 3.note: Material 3 role tones (color_spec_2021.js), as greys of the same L*; hover and pressed are 8% and 10% state layers

Radix.note: @radix-ui/colors, using the documented purpose of each step (slate for neutrals, blue 9 for the fill)

Chakra UI.note: @chakra-ui/react v3 semantic tokens (bg, bg.subtle, bg.muted, bg.emphasized, border, border.emphasized, gray.solid, fg, fg.muted)

Apple (iOS).note: Apple HIG Color specifications: system greys 6, 5, 4 and gray, and blue; roles approximate

MUI (Material UI).note: @mui/material createTheme defaults; the strong border is the outlined input border MUI hard-codes at 23%; in dark mode, MUI lightens paper by elevation overlays, not measured here

shadcn/ui.note: shadcn/ui v4 site theme (apps/v4/app/globals.css on GitHub, main branch, 29 Oct 2026); hover is the accent token used for ghost-button and menu hovers

Mantine.note: @mantine/core styles.css: body, default, default-hover, gray-3 or dark-4 (borders), default-border, blue-filled, text, dimmed

daisyUI.note: daisyui 5 themes; borders and muted text are made with opacity in components, so not measured

Uber Base Web.note: baseui themes; inputs are filled, so their border is nearly invisible
